note: Generated by Contact Stress Predictor/pipeline/fixture_build.py from the trained phyContactGAN checkpoint, which is NOT in this repository. 'probes'/'native*'/'store*' are the model itself; 'recon*' is what public/tools/contact-stress reconstructs. Regenerate whenever the artifact is re-baked.

source.citation: Lang, H., Villamil, W. D., and Al-Qadi, I. L. (2026). 3D tire-pavement contact stresses: physics-informed prediction approach. International Journal of Pavement Engineering, 27(1), 2621970.
source.model: phyContactGAN - Pix2Pix Skip-U-Net generator, Table 5 checkpoint
source.tire: 275/80R22.5 truck tire on a 22.5 in rim (DTA); wide-base tire (WBT)
source.note: Precomputed sample of the trained generator output over its full training domain, compressed to a shared PCA basis per tire and channel. The network and its weights are not distributed.
